h BM25 or optional Ollama/OpenAI embeddings.
# DSH Tool Search

A native DeepSeek Harness
(DSH) plugin that finds tools when an AI agent needs them.
It searches bui

lt-in DSH tools, plugin tools and MCP tools, then exposes the
selected schemas on the next agent ste

p. Search does not execute tools or
change their permissions.

Keep a small, configurable set of tools always available; discover the rest with
`tool_search` and r

emove unused schemas with `tool_unload`. Each agent has its
own set of up to 16 additional tools. Na
tive and PTC presets are supported.

Use local **BM25 tool search**, or add **semantic search** through Ollama or an
OpenAI-compatible em

beddings API. It works with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
tools alongside native tools, without runni
ng another MCP server.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** and **Node.js 24**.
- A working DSH profile; the examples below us

e `web`.
- Embeddings are optional. Search works without Ollama or an API key when
**Use embeddings*

- Embeddings are optional. Search works without Ollama or an API key when
**Use embeddings** is off.

The npm package is **`@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search`**. The unscoped
`dsh-tool-search` package belongs
to another project.
## Install
Install the stable release into your DSH profile:

To try a published release candidate:

For reproducibility, replace the tag with an exact published version. You can
also download a prebui

lt `.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS` from
GitHub Releases, verify
its SHA-256, and pass its absolute path to t

he same installation command.
Follow DSH's reload/restart message. Do not use `npm install -g`: DSH

activates
plugins through profile bundles, not npm's global package directory.
### Updating an earlier local installation

Back up the profile manifest, lockfile and Cordis patch first. Remove the old
local `dsh-tool-search

` bundle through `dsh plugin --profile web remove`, then
add the scoped package. Preserve the `dsh-t

ool-search` row ID and its config;
replace any old explicit package-name override with the scoped na

me. Do not
activate both packages: they register the same two tools. Credentials and the
vector cach
e stay in the same locations. See the release and migration guide.
## Use
The agent first searches for a capability:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Pass this to `tool_search`. After it returns, the next model step receives the
original `workflow` s

chema. The agent can then call `workflow` with the arguments
required by that schema and the usual D
SH permission checks.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`tool_search` defaults to hybrid search with three results (maximum five).
Use an exact tool name or

a focused task description. An empty query returns a
compact inventory. `tool_unload({"names":["wor

kflow"]})` removes a discovered
schema; `tool_unload({})` removes all additionally loaded schemas. T

ools configured
as always available cannot be unloaded.
## Configure
Open **Plugins → @swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search → dsh-tool-search → Configure**.

- **Always available tools:** one tool name per line. The default includes 39
tools for files, workf

lows, background jobs, scheduling, goals and agents.
`tool_search` and `tool_unload` always remain a

vailable.
- **Use embeddings:** turn off for fully local BM25 search, with no embedding
network requ

ests. This intentional mode is not reported as degraded.
- **Ollama:** default provider, model `qwen

3-embedding:4b`. Install your selected
model yourself; the plugin never downloads models.
- **OpenAI

-compatible:** set model, API base URL and credential reference.
Defaults are `text-embedding-3-smal

l` and `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
Save keys through the DSH credential control; stored plaintext i

s never shown.
This control requires a writable DSH credential service. If it is unavailable,
supply
`DSH_TOOL_SEARCH_OPENAI_API_KEY` in the DSH process environment instead.

Settings apply to the next search. An in-flight search retains its original
settings, and switching

providers preserves each provider's configuration.
Saving settings alone never calls an embeddings A

viders preserves each provider's configuration.
Saving settings alone never calls an embeddings API.
## Privacy and limitations

An enabled remote embedding provider receives the query and prepared tool
descriptions. BM25 and pat

tern search are local. Exact-name searches do not
request embeddings. Provider errors fall back to B
M25 with `degraded: true`.

The vector cache stores hashes and vectors under `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tool-search`,
not queries, raw

catalogs or keys. Search preserves registry scope and DSH access
checks. Unloading schemas does not

remove earlier conversation messages, skill
catalogs or tool results. Smaller schema payloads do no

t by themselves prove
lower total task cost; include caching and extra search calls in comparisons.

See tool/provider details, the
public contract and benchmark methodology.
## Update or remove

tools and filtering
; the underlying DSH/plugin/MCP tools remain registered.

CodeQL. Releases us

e SemVer, Keep a Changelog and Conventional Commits. Candidates
use `next`; stable versions use `lat

est`. See CONTRIBUTING.md,
the release procedure and SECURITY.md.
